Remaining: shark, goldfish, salmon (fish); frog, snake, crocodile, turtle (reptiles, except frog is an amphibian).

Asking "Is it a fish?" splits 3/4. Asking "Is it a reptile?" splits 3 (snake, crocodile, turtle) against 4. Neither is a clean split.

Other options:
- "Does it live in the ocean?" gives shark and salmon (arguably), maybe whale-like cases, so it is ambiguous.
- "Does it have four legs?" gives frog, crocodile, turtle against the rest, a 3/4 split with ambiguity.
- "Does it lay eggs?" is true for all of them, so it is useless.

I'll go with "Is it a fish?", since it is clear-cut.
